subject.title: feat(mcp): open App views from channel replies

question: Should OpenClaw intentionally expose short-lived standalone MCP App bearer tickets through channel messages whenever a Gateway Funnel or preserved Funnel is available?
rationale: The implementation is designed to make the ticket opaque and short lived, but it introduces a new channel-to-browser access path that can be internet reachable and is not merely a mechanical correction.

options.title: Approve bounded Funnel launch links
options.body: Accept the two-minute opaque-ticket model for channel recipients and require the promised exact-head Desktop proof before merge.

options.title: Limit to tailnet-only links
options.body: Allow channel launch actions only for Tailscale Serve and omit them when the published origin is internet reachable.

options.title: Add explicit operator opt-in
options.body: Require a dedicated documented opt-in before emitting a public Funnel launch link from a channel reply.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded Funnel launch links
recommendation.body: Accept the two-minute opaque-ticket model for channel recipients and require the promised exact-head Desktop proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged Telegram prerequisite and the proposed cross-channel launch path, so they are best placed to provide the intended security and UX contract before broader owner review.
